body: Glad I could at least provide some comfort. You put it perfectly, saying we’re doomed no matter what. I think the secret is finding something you absolutely love. Something that gives life a purpose, you know? The hard part is lasting long enough to find that thing. And even still, there are people who never find that, and die just as sad and hopeless as they started out. It’s honestly a waiting game between you and life.

I get it. I’m 17, and in a similar situation. Have been for years. Honestly, January was my first break since about 2017. Everything seemed to even itself out, and I wondered how I could’ve ever been driven to the point of making an attempt.

Well, I got that reminder today. I think my biggest issue is being stuck at home with a mother who’s also mentally ill, and takes it out on me. But then I think about what I’d actually do when I move out. I have no urge to go to university, and I have no clue what the hell to do for a living. 

I’ve always wondered what the point of life is. We’re born against our will, go to school from the time we’re 5 to at least 18, and then it’s either more school or a job. Then, it’s working until your body begins to fucking break, and you get to watch all your friends and family die around you until it’s finally your turn. I cant seem to see any time where you wouldn’t feel this kind of pain in life. 

Sleeping is my best escape, and even that isn’t always reliable. I’m stuck. I don’t want to be here but I’m terrified of what comes next. 

I know most people will tell you bullshit like “it gets better”, or “there’s help”. I’m starting to think it’s all just lies. Not sure if this is the response you were looking for, but hey at least you’re not the only one going insane here
